mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) compresses corporate cash flows and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher cost of capital. The signal activates when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or the signal fails to outperform a random walk (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of high FEDFUNDS (>5.0%) and high CPIAUCSL (>200) signals monetary tightening and inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative 20-day returns. The interaction is the driver.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce negative returns when both exceed thresholds (FEDFUNDS>5.0% and CPIAUCSL>200), or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity and equity demand.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS signals do not produce negative returns >60% of the time, or fail to distinguish from non-tightening cycles (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings and equity demand, producing positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.5%, 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or the signal fails to outperform a random walk (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1800) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through increased business investment.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1800, 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or the signal fails to outperform a random walk (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between strong housing starts (HOUST > 1800) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1 > 11000) signals sustained economic momentum, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns via elevated corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The HOUST-GDPC1 interaction does not produce positive returns when both exceed thresholds (HOUST>1800 and GDPC1>11000), or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production (INDPRO < 110) indicates economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings and equity demand, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 110, 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or the signal fails to outperform a random walk (p > 0.05).
